examples.text_en: The ostracism of the young man was very hard.
examples.text_zh: 对这个年轻人的排斥让他很难熬。

examples.text_en: He lived in ostracism for many long years.
examples.text_zh: 他在被排斥中生活了许多年。

examples.text_en: The group would ostracize any man who left.
examples.text_zh: 这个团体排斥任何离开的人。

examples.text_en: They tried to ostracize him from the small town.
examples.text_zh: 他们试图把他赶出这个小镇。

examples.text_en: He was other-directed and never had a thought.
examples.text_zh: 他凡事随大流，从没有自己的想法。

examples.text_en: Her other-directed ways made her easy to lead.
examples.text_zh: 她随俗的性格让她容易被人牵着走。

examples.text_en: The extra meeting proved otiose in the end.
examples.text_zh: 那次额外的会议最终证明是多余的。

examples.text_en: Such idle worries are otiose and wasteful.
examples.text_zh: 这些无谓的担忧既多余又浪费。

examples.text_en: Ottawa is a city in the north country.
examples.text_zh: 渥太华是北方那个国家的一座城市。

examples.text_en: She moved to Ottawa for a new job.
examples.text_zh: 她为了新工作搬到了渥太华。

examples.text_en: An otter played in the deep water there.
examples.text_zh: 一只水獭在那边的深水里玩耍。

examples.text_en: The otter is a good friend of the sea.
examples.text_zh: 水獭是海洋的好朋友。

examples.text_en: The board voted to oust the chief officer.
examples.text_zh: 董事会投票决定罢免这位主管。

examples.text_en: Rebels tried to oust the city mayor.
examples.text_zh: 反对者试图把市长赶下台。

examples.text_en: The outcast man had no home and no friend.
examples.text_zh: 这个被逐出的人没有家，也没有朋友。

examples.text_en: They made him an outcast in his own town.
examples.text_zh: 他们让他在自己的镇子里成了无家可归的人。

examples.text_en: The new tax caused a public outcry.
examples.text_zh: 新税引发了公众的强烈抗议。

examples.text_en: There was an outcry against the sudden decision.
examples.text_zh: 人们对这个突然的决定发出了抗议。

examples.text_en: His outdated views annoyed the younger staff.
examples.text_zh: 他过时的观点让年轻员工很反感。

examples.text_en: This outdated machine still works quite well.
examples.text_zh: 这台过时的机器仍然运转得不错。

examples.text_en: He will try to outdo his own brother.
examples.text_zh: 他会设法胜过自己的兄弟。

examples.text_en: No one can outdo her at this kind of work.
examples.text_zh: 在干这类工作上，谁也比不过她。

examples.text_en: The outermost layer protects the inner parts.
examples.text_zh: 最外面的一层保护着里面的部分。

examples.text_en: The outermost leaves catch the morning light.
examples.text_zh: 最外面的叶子最先接住晨光。

examples.text_en: She can outfox any man in this game.
examples.text_zh: 在这场游戏里，她能智胜任何人。

examples.text_en: He tried to outfox them but lost the game.
examples.text_zh: 他想耍计谋胜过他们，却输了比赛。

examples.text_en: Children quickly outgrow their winter clothes.
examples.text_zh: 孩子们很快就长得穿不下冬衣了。

examples.text_en: He has outgrown his fear of the water.
examples.text_zh: 他已经不再怕水了。

examples.text_en: This new group is an outgrowth of that one.
examples.text_zh: 这个新团体是那个团体发展而来的。

examples.text_en: Their success was an outgrowth of long work.
examples.text_zh: 他们的成功是长期努力的结果。

examples.text_en: We had an outing in the green fields today.
examples.text_zh: 我们今天在绿色田野里远足。

examples.text_en: The school outing was short but very good.
examples.text_zh: 学校的郊游很短，但很有趣。

examples.text_en: He told an outlandish story about the sea.
examples.text_zh: 他讲了一个关于大海的离奇故事。

examples.text_en: Her outlandish ways were new to the town.
examples.text_zh: 她古怪的作风对小镇来说很新鲜。

examples.text_en: Good books can outlast their authors by centuries.
examples.text_zh: 好书能比作者流传更久，长达几个世纪。

examples.text_en: These stone walls will outlast the wooden roof.
examples.text_zh: 这些石墙会比木屋顶更长久。

examples.text_en: The outlaw ran from the law for years.
examples.text_zh: 这个罪犯多年来一直逃避法律的追捕。

examples.text_en: They called him an outlaw and took his land.
examples.text_zh: 他们称他为罪犯，没收了他的土地。

examples.text_en: The outlying town had no school and no work.
examples.text_zh: 这个边远的小镇没有学校，也没有工作。

examples.text_en: They live in an outlying part of the city.
examples.text_zh: 他们住在城市偏僻的一角。

examples.text_en: They tried to outmaneuver us at the meeting.
examples.text_zh: 他们想在会上用计谋胜过我们。

examples.text_en: A good plan can outmaneuver a strong group.
examples.text_zh: 好的计划能智胜一个强大的团体。

examples.text_en: This outmoded form is no longer of use.
examples.text_zh: 这种过时的形式已经不再有用。

examples.text_en: They called his ideas outmoded and left.
examples.text_zh: 他们说他想法过时了，便离开了。

examples.text_en: The output of this small team was very good.
examples.text_zh: 这个小团队的产量非常好。

examples.text_en: They wanted more output from the same group.
examples.text_zh: 他们希望同一个团队有更高的产量。

examples.text_en: The decision caused public outrage across the country.
examples.text_zh: 这一决定在全国引起了公众的愤怒。

examples.text_en: He could not hide his outrage at the news.
examples.text_zh: 他无法掩饰对这个消息的愤怒。

examples.text_en: His outrageous behavior shocked the guests.
examples.text_zh: 他无礼的行为让客人们震惊。

examples.text_en: That is an outrageous demand to make.
examples.text_zh: 提出这样的要求实在太过分了。

examples.text_en: His answer was an outright no to the plan.
examples.text_zh: 他的回答是对这个计划的彻底拒绝。

examples.text_en: She said an outright no to the group.
examples.text_zh: 她直截了当地对大家说了不行。

examples.text_en: He told us the plan at the very outset.
examples.text_zh: 他一开头就告诉了我们这个计划。

examples.text_en: From the outset, the work was hard for them.
examples.text_zh: 从一开始，这项工作对他们就很难。

examples.text_en: Her talent outshines that of her classmates.
examples.text_zh: 她的才华胜过她的同学。

examples.text_en: No one can outshine him on the stage.
examples.text_zh: 在舞台上没人能比他更出彩。

examples.text_en: They live on the outskirt of the big city.
examples.text_zh: 他们住在这座大城市的郊外。

examples.text_en: The outskirt was full of green fields.
examples.text_zh: 郊外到处都是绿色的田野。

examples.text_en: She is an outspoken critic of the plan.
examples.text_zh: 她是这项计划直言不讳的批评者。

examples.text_en: He became outspoken after leaving the company.
examples.text_zh: 离开公司后，他变得直言不讳。

examples.text_en: Demand may outstrip supply this winter.
examples.text_zh: 今年冬天需求可能超过供给。

examples.text_en: Their sales outstripped those of every rival.
examples.text_zh: 他们的销量超过了所有竞争对手。

examples.text_en: The outward form of the house was very simple.
examples.text_zh: 这栋房子的外观非常简单。

examples.text_en: His outward life seemed good to everyone.
examples.text_zh: 他表面上的生活对大家来说都很好。

examples.text_en: The clever fox outwitted the hungry wolf.
examples.text_zh: 聪明的狐狸智胜了饥饿的狼。

examples.text_en: She outwits her rivals with careful planning.
examples.text_zh: 她靠周密的计划智胜对手。

examples.text_en: The singer received a long standing ovation.
examples.text_zh: 歌手获得了长时间起立鼓掌的欢呼。

examples.text_en: The crowd gave the team a warm ovation.
examples.text_zh: 人群向球队报以热烈的欢呼。

examples.text_en: He leaned too far and began to overbalance.
examples.text_zh: 他身体探得太远，开始失去平衡。

examples.text_en: The heavy load may overbalance the small boat.
examples.text_zh: 沉重的货物可能使小船倾覆。

examples.text_en: His overbearing ways made the group feel small.
examples.text_zh: 他傲慢的作风让大家觉得自己很渺小。

examples.text_en: The overbearing man would not hear any other view.
examples.text_zh: 这个傲慢的人听不进任何别的看法。

examples.text_en: Extra duties overburden the few remaining staff.
examples.text_zh: 额外的任务使仅剩的少数员工不堪重负。

examples.text_en: Do not overburden the young students with homework.
examples.text_zh: 不要用作业压垮年轻的学生。

examples.text_en: They will overcharge people from out of town.
examples.text_zh: 他们会向从外地来的人多收钱。

examples.text_en: Do not overcharge us for this small job.
examples.text_zh: 别为这点小活儿多收我们的钱。

examples.text_en: The library books are now two weeks overdue.
examples.text_zh: 这些图书馆的书现在逾期两周了。

examples.text_en: Your payment is long overdue now.
examples.text_zh: 你的付款早就逾期了。

examples.text_en: The overexposure of the film made it dark.
examples.text_zh: 底片曝光过度，变得很暗。

examples.text_en: They did not like the overexposure of that light.
examples.text_zh: 他们不喜欢那道光的过度曝光。

examples.text_en: The heavy rain caused an overflow of the river.
examples.text_zh: 大雨导致河水泛滥。

examples.text_en: An overflow of water flooded the small street.
examples.text_zh: 溢出的水淹没了小街。

examples.text_en: A rock overhang gave us shelter from rain.
examples.text_zh: 一处岩石的突出部分为我们挡住了雨。

examples.text_en: The overhang of the roof keeps the door dry.
examples.text_zh: 屋檐的突出部分使门口保持干燥。

examples.text_en: The engine needs a complete overhaul soon.
examples.text_zh: 这台发动机很快需要彻底检修。

examples.text_en: They will overhaul the bridge next summer.
examples.text_zh: 他们明年夏天将彻底翻修这座桥。

examples.text_en: We did not mean to overhear their talk.
examples.text_zh: 我们不是有意偷听他们谈话。

examples.text_en: She would overhear the two men at night.
examples.text_zh: 夜里她会无意中听到那两个人的谈话。

examples.text_en: The two plans had overlapping forms and rules.
examples.text_zh: 这两个计划的形式和规则有重叠。

examples.text_en: Their work was overlapping and took too long.
examples.text_zh: 他们的工作互相重叠，花的时间太长。

examples.text_en: The new overpass crosses the busy highway.
examples.text_zh: 新天桥横跨繁忙的公路。

examples.text_en: Cars passed under the concrete overpass slowly.
examples.text_zh: 汽车缓缓地从混凝土天桥下驶过。

examples.text_en: The overpowering air made us leave the room.
examples.text_zh: 那股压倒性的气味让我们离开了房间。

examples.text_en: His overpowering power was hard to question.
examples.text_zh: 他那压倒性的权力让人难以质疑。

examples.text_en: He overreached and lost the deal.
examples.text_zh: 他做得太过头，结果丢了这笔交易。

examples.text_en: Companies often overreach when they expand too fast.
examples.text_zh: 公司在扩张过快时往往做得过头。

examples.text_en: The judge can override the earlier decision.
examples.text_zh: 法官可以推翻先前的裁决。

examples.text_en: Safety concerns override all other interests.
examples.text_zh: 安全问题高于其他一切利益。

examples.text_en: The scan showed overriding where the bones met.
examples.text_zh: 扫描显示骨头相接处出现了重迭。

examples.text_en: Doctors noted overriding in the broken arm.
examples.text_zh: 医生注意到断臂处有骨端重迭。

examples.text_en: The chairman may overrule the committee's decision.
examples.text_zh: 主席可以否决委员会的决定。

examples.text_en: The judge overruled every objection from the lawyer.
examples.text_zh: 法官驳回了律师的每一次异议。

examples.text_en: An overrun of insects damaged the crops.
examples.text_zh: 害虫的蔓延毁坏了庄稼。

examples.text_en: The overrun spread quickly through the wet fields.
examples.text_zh: 这种蔓延很快遍及潮湿的田地。

examples.text_en: The oversecretion of this form caused the pain.
examples.text_zh: 这种物质的分泌过多引起了疼痛。

examples.text_en: They studied the oversecretion in the young boy.
examples.text_zh: 他们研究了那个小男孩分泌过多的问题。

examples.text_en: She will oversee the project this year.
examples.text_zh: 她今年将监督这个项目。

examples.text_en: A senior manager oversees the daily work.
examples.text_zh: 一位资深经理监督日常工作。

examples.text_en: Dark clouds overshadowed the small mountain village.
examples.text_zh: 乌云笼罩着这个小山村。

examples.text_en: His success overshadowed the efforts of others.
examples.text_zh: 他的成功使别人的努力黯然失色。

examples.text_en: Do not overstate the risks of the plan.
examples.text_zh: 不要夸大这个计划的风险。

examples.text_en: He tends to overstate his own importance.
examples.text_zh: 他往往夸大自己的重要性。

examples.text_en: There was no overt sign of trouble.
examples.text_zh: 没有明显的不安迹象。

examples.text_en: Her overt hostility surprised the other guests.
examples.text_zh: 她明显的敌意让其他客人吃惊。

examples.text_en: The new law would overtax the poor family.
examples.text_zh: 新法律会让这个贫穷的家庭交过重的税。

examples.text_en: They did not want to overtax the small town.
examples.text_zh: 他们不想对小镇课以重税。

examples.text_en: She looked tired and clearly overtaxed.
examples.text_zh: 她看起来很累，显然负担过重。

examples.text_en: The staff were overtaxed by endless requests.
examples.text_zh: 员工们被没完没了的要求压得喘不过气。

examples.text_en: Long games can overtire young children.
examples.text_zh: 长时间的游戏会让幼儿过度疲劳。

examples.text_en: Do not overtire yourself before the race.
examples.text_zh: 比赛前不要让自己过度疲劳。

examples.text_en: They made an overture to the other group.
examples.text_zh: 他们向另一个团体主动示好。

examples.text_en: His overture was met with a clear no.
examples.text_zh: 他的提议被明确拒绝了。

examples.text_en: His overweening ways made him lose friends.
examples.text_zh: 他自负的作风让他失去了朋友。

examples.text_en: The overweening young man would not listen.
examples.text_zh: 这个自负的年轻人不肯听人劝。

examples.text_en: The overwhelming support made the plan a success.
examples.text_zh: 压倒性的支持让这个计划获得了成功。

examples.text_en: There was an overwhelming call for change.
examples.text_zh: 要求变革的呼声压倒一切。

examples.text_en: The group was overwhelmingly for the new plan.
examples.text_zh: 这群人以压倒性多数支持新计划。

examples.text_en: They won the vote overwhelmingly last week.
examples.text_zh: 他们上周以压倒性优势赢得了投票。

examples.text_en: She was overwrought after the long hard day.
examples.text_zh: 漫长辛苦的一天之后，她紧张过度。

examples.text_en: The overwrought man could not think or sleep.
examples.text_zh: 这个过度劳累的人既不能思考，也无法入睡。

examples.text_en: The two oxen took the big box home.
examples.text_zh: 两头牛把大箱子拉回了家。

examples.text_en: He used oxen to work the green fields.
examples.text_zh: 他用牛来耕作绿色的田地。

examples.text_en: Rust is an oxide formed on iron.
examples.text_zh: 铁锈是铁上形成的一种氧化物。

examples.text_en: The soil contains oxides of several metals.
examples.text_zh: 这种土壤含有几种金属的氧化物。

examples.text_en: Iron will oxidize quickly in wet air.
examples.text_zh: 铁在潮湿的空气中会很快氧化。

examples.text_en: Air can oxidize the surface of the metal.
examples.text_zh: 空气会使金属表面氧化。

examples.text_en: We will meet again at three P.M. today.
examples.text_zh: 我们今天下午三点再见。

examples.text_en: The door was closed at five P.M. today.
examples.text_zh: 今天下午五点门就关了。

examples.text_en: The pacifist said no to the war.
examples.text_zh: 这位和平主义者对战争说了不。

examples.text_en: He was a pacifist in a time of war.
examples.text_zh: 在战争年代，他是个和平主义者。

examples.text_en: He tried to pacify the angry crowd.
examples.text_zh: 他设法使愤怒的人群平静下来。

examples.text_en: A warm meal can pacify a crying child.
examples.text_zh: 一顿热饭能让哭闹的孩子平静下来。

examples.text_en: The packaging of this food is very simple.
examples.text_zh: 这种食物的包装非常简单。

examples.text_en: Good packaging can keep the food safe.
examples.text_zh: 好的包装能让食物保持安全。

examples.text_en: The packer put the boxes on the long table.
examples.text_zh: 包装工人把箱子放在长桌上。

examples.text_en: A packer must work with a lot of care.
examples.text_zh: 包装工人必须非常细心。

examples.text_en: The jacket has thick padding inside.
examples.text_zh: 这件夹克里面有厚厚的衬垫。

examples.text_en: Remove the padding before washing the coat.
examples.text_zh: 洗外套前先把衬垫取出来。

examples.text_en: He used a paddle in the deep water.
examples.text_zh: 他在深水里用桨划动。

examples.text_en: The paddle was long and hard to hold.
examples.text_zh: 这支桨很长，很难握住。

examples.text_en: The paddler moved through the water with care.
examples.text_zh: 划桨者小心地划过水面。

examples.text_en: A good paddler can read the water well.
examples.text_zh: 好的划桨者很懂水性。

examples.text_en: The poem is a paean to nature.
examples.text_zh: 这首诗是对大自然的赞美歌。

examples.text_en: They sang a paean in honor of the hero.
examples.text_zh: 他们唱起凯歌纪念这位英雄。

examples.text_en: The pagans built a temple on the hill.
examples.text_zh: 异教徒在山上建了一座神庙。

examples.text_en: Ancient pagan customs survived in the village.
examples.text_zh: 古老的异教习俗在村里流传下来。

examples.text_en: He put the water in a big pail.
examples.text_zh: 他把水倒进一个大桶里。

examples.text_en: The pail was full and hard to hold.
examples.text_zh: 桶装满了，很难提。

examples.text_en: They gave him a painkiller for the pain.
examples.text_zh: 他们给他一片止痛药来止痛。

examples.text_en: This painkiller is not safe for young children.
examples.text_zh: 这种止痛药对小孩不安全。

examples.text_en: The soup was thin but quite palatable.
examples.text_zh: 这汤虽然稀，但相当可口。

examples.text_en: They served a palatable meal to the guests.
examples.text_zh: 他们给客人端上了一顿美味的饭菜。

examples.text_en: They stayed in a palatial hotel downtown.
examples.text_zh: 他们住在市中心一家宫殿般的酒店里。

examples.text_en: Her palatial home has forty rooms.
examples.text_zh: 她宫殿般的家中有四十个房间。

examples.text_en: There was a lot of palaver before the work.
examples.text_zh: 干这活儿之前费了许多口舌。

examples.text_en: He did not like such palaver at the meeting.
examples.text_zh: 他不喜欢会上这种空谈。

examples.text_en: They found Paleolithic tools in the cave.
examples.text_zh: 他们在洞穴里发现了旧石器时代的工具。

examples.text_en: Paleolithic people painted animals on cave walls.
examples.text_zh: 旧石器时代的人在洞壁上画动物。

examples.text_en: The paleontologist walked through the dark ground.
examples.text_zh: 这位古生物学者走过黑暗的土地。

examples.text_en: A paleontologist gave a talk at our school.
examples.text_zh: 一位古生物学者在我们学校做了讲座。

examples.text_en: He studies paleontology at a large university.
examples.text_zh: 他在一所大型大学里研究古生物学。

examples.text_en: Paleontology is not a common field for us.
examples.text_zh: 对我们来说，古生物学不是个常见的领域。

examples.text_en: The garden was fenced with wooden palings.
examples.text_zh: 花园用木栏围了起来。

examples.text_en: A few palings had fallen from the fence.
examples.text_zh: 有几根木栏从篱笆上掉了下来。

examples.text_en: A dark pall covered the coffin.
examples.text_zh: 一块深色的棺罩盖在棺材上。

examples.text_en: A pall of smoke hung over the city.
examples.text_zh: 一层烟雾笼罩着这座城市。

examples.text_en: This can palliate the pain for a time.
examples.text_zh: 这能暂时减轻疼痛。

examples.text_en: They tried to palliate the problem with words.
examples.text_zh: 他们想用言语来缓和这个问题。

examples.text_en: They found only a palliative for the pain.
examples.text_zh: 他们只找到了一种缓解疼痛的办法。

examples.text_en: This is a palliative form of help, not a real one.
examples.text_zh: 这只是缓和性的帮助，不是真正的解决办法。

examples.text_en: His face was pallid after the long night.
examples.text_zh: 漫漫长夜之后，他的脸色苍白。

examples.text_en: The pallid light of the morning was clear.
examples.text_zh: 清晨暗淡的光线很清晰。

examples.text_en: In its palmy days the town was full of life.
examples.text_zh: 在繁荣的岁月里，这个小镇充满生机。

examples.text_en: Those were the palmy years of his own work.
examples.text_zh: 那是他自己事业的鼎盛岁月。

examples.text_en: The tension in the room was palpable.
examples.text_zh: 房间里的紧张气氛是能感觉到的。

examples.text_en: There was a palpable change in his mood.
examples.text_zh: 他的情绪有明显的变化。

examples.text_en: His heart would palpitate at the first light.
examples.text_zh: 天刚亮时，他的心就怦怦直跳。

examples.text_en: Her heart would palpitate in the dark.
examples.text_zh: 在黑暗中，她的心会悸动。

examples.text_en: Do not palter with me about this problem.
examples.text_zh: 别在这个问题上跟我含糊其词。

examples.text_en: He would palter and never give a clear answer.
examples.text_zh: 他总是敷衍，从不给明确的答复。

examples.text_en: They gave him a paltry form of help.
examples.text_zh: 他们只给了他一点微不足道的帮助。

examples.text_en: His paltry reason helped no one at all.
examples.text_zh: 他那点微不足道的理由对谁都没用。

examples.text_en: They pamper their dog with fancy food.
examples.text_zh: 他们用精美的食物溺爱他们的狗。

examples.text_en: She likes to pamper herself on weekends.
examples.text_zh: 她喜欢在周末犒劳自己。

examples.text_en: More money is not a panacea for every problem.
examples.text_zh: 更多的钱并不是解决一切问题的灵丹妙药。

examples.text_en: They called the new law a panacea.
examples.text_zh: 他们称这项新法律为万能药。

examples.text_en: He did the hard work with style and panache.
examples.text_zh: 他带着风度与派头做完了这项艰难的工作。

examples.text_en: Her panache made the show a success.
examples.text_zh: 她的派头让演出获得了成功。

examples.text_en: The pancreas is an important part of the body.
examples.text_zh: 胰腺是身体的一个重要部分。

examples.text_en: They studied the work of the pancreas in the body.
examples.text_zh: 他们研究胰腺在体内的工作。
